readings: For each film rating, show the rating, the average `replacement_cost` of its films, the per-day rental price (the rating's average `rental_rate` divided by its average `rental_duration`), and that per-day price divided by the simple mean of the per-day prices of all ratings (each rating counted once). Do not round anything.
queries:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
         AVG(rental_rate) * 1.0 / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT rating,
       avg_replacement_cost,
       per_day_price,
       per_day_price / (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) FROM r) AS relative_per_day_price
FROM r;
